title: Targeting Colon Cancer Cells with Pyrazino-Imidazolinone Derivatives: Synthesis, Molecular Docking, and in Vitro Evaluation of Anti-Proliferative and Pro-Apoptotic Activities.
authors: Tambat, Nazia; Tambe, Pranav; Shaikh, Amin; Shiekh, Kounsar N; Kohler, Leonhard H F; Schobert, Rainer; Biersack, Bernhard; Ahmed, Khursheed
one_liner_zh: 该文研究吡嗪-咪唑啉酮衍生物的抗癌活性，分子对接对象为EGFR和酪氨酸酶蛋白，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA体系无关，仅方法上分子对接可借鉴但对象和方法均不匹配。
abstract: We report the synthesis, spectroscopic characterization, molecular docking and biological evaluation of nine pyrazino-imidazolinone derivatives. These derivatives were evaluated for their anticancer activity against three cancer cell lines: 518A2 melanoma, HCT-116, and HCT-116 p53 knockout mutant colon carcinoma. The MTT assay was employed to assess their effectiveness. Among the nine compounds tested, four compounds (5 a, 5 d, 5 g, and 5 h) exhibited promising antiproliferative activity specifically against HCT-116 p53-negative cells (IC(50) 0.23, 0.20, 2.07 and 58.75 muM, respectively). Interestingly, treatment with the 3,4-dimethoxyphenyl derivative 5a resulted in a significant increase (199 %) in caspase activity in HCT-116 p53-negative cells compared to untreated cells while the bromo-pyrazine derivative 5d demonstrated (190 %) increase. These findings suggest that compounds 5a and 5 d induce p53-independent apoptotic cell death. Additionally, in silico molecular docking studies with EGFR and tyrosinase proteins indicated that compounds 5 d and 5 e have the potential to bind to important anticancer drug targets.
abstract_zh: 我们报道了九种吡嗪并咪唑啉酮衍生物的合成、光谱表征、分子对接及生物学评价。这些衍生物针对三种癌细胞系进行了抗癌活性评估：518A2黑色素瘤、HCT-116及HCT-116 p53敲除突变结肠癌。采用MTT法评估其有效性。在测试的九种化合物中，四种化合物（5a、5d、5g和5h）表现出针对HCT-116 p53阴性细胞的特异性抗增殖活性（IC(50)分别为0.23、0.20、2.07和58.75 μM）。有趣的是，与未处理细胞相比，用3,4-二甲氧基苯基衍生物5a处理HCT-116 p53阴性细胞导致caspase活性显著增加（199%），而溴代吡嗪衍生物5d则显示出190%的增加。这些发现表明，化合物5a和5d诱导p53非依赖性凋亡性细胞死亡。此外，与EGFR和酪氨酸酶蛋白的计算机分子对接研究表明，化合物5d和5e具有结合重要抗癌药物靶点的潜力。
